formulae.title: Parametric L-system tree production rule
formulae.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mi>ω</mi><mi>:</mi><mi>A</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>;</mi><mspace width="1em" /><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mi>:</mi><mi>A</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>s</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>:</mi><mo>*</mo><mo>→</mo><mi>F</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>s</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mo>+</mo><mi>A</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>s</mi><mo>/</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">]</mo><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mo>−</mo><mi>A</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>s</mi><mo>/</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">]</mo><mi>F</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>s</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>A</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>s</mi><mo>/</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math>
formulae.basic_explanation: Each branch segment rewrites into a forward step, two child branches at ±angle with length scaled down by R, and a continuing trunk — a turtle-graphics interpretation of the rewriting rule produces the self-similar branching structure.

citation.chicago: Prusinkiewicz, Przemysław, and Aristid Lindenmayer. 2004. The Algorithmic Beauty of Plants. New York: Springer.
